##### Project general facts

Azizi Florence by Azizi Developments is a large master-planned community designed as a harmonious blend of nature, architecture and family living. The community is arranged in six clusters, with Lucardo, Bellarno and Soffiano in a contemporary style and Versilia, Pienza and Siena radiating Mediterranean charm. It offers three- and four-bedroom townhouses and four-, five- and six-bedroom villas, each with a maid's room, together with apartments.

A central community park with basketball, tennis and volleyball courts, dancing fountains, jogging tracks and children's play areas forms the heart of the community, alongside a community mall with a retail and fashion district. Each cluster has its own clubhouse with separate indoor and outdoor pools, gyms, saunas, steam rooms and jacuzzis for men and women, a mosque, a park with seating, barbecue areas and everyday shops, pharmacies and barber shops.

Villas feature two-level living spaces, rooftop terraces and private lifts, while every home enjoys a private pool and a landscaped backyard. Interiors blend with the green surroundings through generous glazing and open, light-filled layouts designed for family comfort. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a complete, ready-to-move-in residence for families and a turnkey option for investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Sharjah is the cultural capital of the UAE, known for its museums, heritage districts, universities and family-oriented way of life. The community sits close to Sharjah International Airport and University City, in an area of expanding residential neighbourhoods, schools, clinics and retail, offering a calm, spacious setting for families who value green surroundings and community living.

Emirates Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Dhaid Road connect residents with Sharjah city centre, Dubai and the northern emirates. Sharjah International Airport is a short drive away, University City and Sharjah city centre are close by, and Dubai International Airport, Deira and Downtown Dubai are within comfortable driving distance for work, study and leisure.

Sharjah allows property ownership for international buyers in designated communities and offers some of the most accessible villa and townhouse prices in the UAE. Spacious family homes with private pools and extensive community facilities appeal to families seeking value close to Dubai. A long-term payment plan, strong road links and growing demand for family living underpin rental demand and long-term value for owners.
